model.name: Shared pan/zoom viewer capability for EVERY embedded format (FUTURE / concept)
model.description: FUTURE / CONCEPT ONLY (Tron 2026-07-20 - do NOT implement now; deferred until Tron authorizes build). The drawer embeds VIEWERS (detail-view types) for many content formats. TODAY only the SVG viewer has rich pan/zoom (RbPanZoom, src/public/ts/trace/pan-zoom.ts:14); other viewers (terminal rb-terminal-detail, images, html, ...) do not, or reimplement ad-hoc. CONCEPT: generalize the SVG viewer's pan/zoom (RbPanZoom) into ONE SHARED viewer base/mixin so EVERY embedded-format viewer pans + zooms CONSISTENTLY - across ALL embeddable content types: pictures (png, gif, webp), svg, html, and 'you name it' (every embeddable format), NOT a subset. A new embeddable format viewer INHERITS pan/zoom for free from the shared base (extensible to future formats). DRY - pan/zoom is NOT reimplemented per viewer/format, exactly the same shared-mechanism doctrine as drawer (R31.4 /trace detail flow), tree (R31.3 rb-trace-tree), template, and badges. Related to R31.5 (shared-mechanism concept) on a DIFFERENT axis: R31.5 = layout/positioning of the drawer/compartments; R31.6 = the pan/zoom CAPABILITY of whatever viewer sits inside. Acceptance = a coherent CONCEPT, not code; each facet decomposes into atomic build-requirements when Tron authorizes implementation (Rule 10/11).
model.tronQuote: > TRON (2026-07-20): all viewers should have the SAME pan/zoom the SVG viewer has - generalize RbPanZoom into a shared viewer base so every drawer viewer pans+zooms; DRY, don't reimplement per viewer. EXTEND: it covers ALL embedded formats - pictures (png, gif, webp), svg, html, 'you name it' - every embeddable content type, extensible to future formats.

discoverySource.note: Shared pan/zoom viewer base generalizing RbPanZoom (pan-zoom.ts:14) so every embedded-format viewer (png/gif/webp/svg/html/... + future) pans+zooms consistently. Captured scenario-first; FUTURE, deferred.

model.crossRefNote: R31.5 = shared-mechanism/DRY concept sibling (layout axis; R31.6 = viewer-capability axis). R31.4 (rb-terminal-detail) is a drawer viewer that would GAIN pan/zoom from the shared base. Prior per-feature pan/zoom uses exist (S21 contact media, S22 traceability-view, S25 apple-dnd, S27 detail-view via RbPanZoom in rb-detail-view / rb-webitem-detail / rb-preview-pane) - R31.6 GENERALIZES those into ONE shared base instead of per-viewer wiring.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The concept establishes pan/zoom as a SHARED viewer capability: the SVG viewer's RbPanZoom (src/public/ts/trace/pan-zoom.ts) is generalized into ONE shared viewer base/mixin, NOT reimplemented per viewer or per format.

EVERY embedded-format viewer pans + zooms CONSISTENTLY via that shared base - across ALL embeddable content types: pictures (png, gif, webp), svg, html, and 'you name it' (every embeddable format), NOT a subset. Same gestures / affordances / zoom limits across formats.

A NEW embeddable-format viewer INHERITS pan/zoom for FREE from the shared base - the capability is extensible to future formats with no per-format reimplementation (same shared-mechanism doctrine as drawer / tree / template / badges).

FUTURE / concept: acceptance is a coherent CONCEPT (this captured model + the architect's shared-viewer-base design), NOT an implementation. Deferred until Tron authorizes build; each facet then decomposes into atomic build-requirements.
